evaluator_identity.rule: the answer-free manifest binds the public commit and byte identity of every required executable and protocol file

candidate_identity.rule: the manifest inventories and hashes the candidate assembly and every non-framework managed dependency; undeclared non-framework assembly fallback is rejected

corpus_identity.qualification: only qualification_state=frozen and contamination_state=clean is admitted
corpus_identity.hash_rule: sha256 of UTF-8: protocol domain newline; corpus_id|version newline; each accepted plugin in load order as load_order|plugin_name|local_installed_entity_id|byte_length|sha256 newline; each unsupported capability in ordinal order as unsupported|capability newline; then oracle|byte_length|sha256(oracle bytes) newline

canonicalization.sets: arrays with a stable public identity are keyed by that identity and sorted ordinally
canonicalization.form_keys: lowercase plugin filename, colon, eight lowercase hexadecimal local-id digits
canonicalization.missing_and_extra: both are product mismatches after valid comparison admission
canonicalization.unsupported_and_gaps: compare as ordinary typed facts; omission is a mismatch
canonicalization.numbers: integers remain integers; non-integers use invariant JSON number text
canonicalization.strings: ordinal, case-sensitive except where the producing public contract already canonicalizes

aggregation: PASS only when every admitted assertion passes; any product mismatch after valid comparison admission is FAIL; malformed candidate output and every other pre-comparison identity, schema, evaluator, corpus, or oracle defect is EVALUATOR_ERROR
result_publication: all serialized outputs are schema-validated before a new result directory is created; path ancestors are reparse-free and pinned against rename on Windows; temporary files publish only after every write is durable; publication failure returns EVALUATOR_ERROR at result_write
